name: foest
description: Plataforma FOEST - Fondo para la Educacion Superior de Tocancipa (monorepo npm workspaces)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,white "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
